properties.description:
The v0.60.0 cut. Four PRs since v0.59.0: #495 (the loop check stops firing twice), #496 (units at the seam and the black-box design reference), #497 (the reflow spirit review, flo2's handoff captured, every oversized reply bounded, two races fixed at the cause), #498 (the registry gets its transport, the per-design cost measured, isolation proven in the image, --ephemeral).

WHAT THIS INCREMENT IS ABOUT, if it has one theme: a consumer project's handoff was answered end to end. All six of flo2's items are closed — one of them by refuting its own premise, two by building the transport that had been half-finished since August, and one by paying a debt that had stood open two and a half weeks because nothing in flo2 can write to this graph.
properties.name: v0.60.0 release cut (2026-09-13)
